column1: # Relocation manifest: the format sample. `cargo xtask refactor relocate` reads tab-separated rows;
# blank lines and lines starting with `#` are skipped, and the first other line is the header.
# This file is the sample the relocation tests run on a throwaway checkout; `--verify` with no
# `--manifest` judges every other `.tsv` in this folder and never this one.
# Columns: kind, from, to, scope. Paths are repository-relative and name the tree before the moves.
# path: git mv one tracked file or folder, then rewrite every reference to it in every tracked text
# file: repository-root and /-root spellings, and ../ literals re-relativised against their anchor.
# A path row takes no scope.
# rust_path: rewrite a Rust path prefix (ending in ::) in the .rs files below the scope folder:
# use trees, paths in code, doc links, comments and string literals; self:: and super:: chains that
# cross the edge of the moved module become absolute crate:: paths first.
# text: rewrite an identifier-like token on word boundaries (letters, digits, _ and - are word
# characters), such as a package name. An empty scope means every live tracked text file; a scope
# holding * or ? is a glob over repository paths.
